body:
We offer several ways to reach our team, and each suits a different need. Some are best for quick questions, others for photos and written records, others for urgent problems. This guide explains each channel, when to use it, what to include in your message so we can help quickly, our customer service hours, what to check before you contact us and how to avoid scams that imitate support. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Our hours
Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Messages sent outside those hours are answered on the next business day, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays. Arizona does not observe daylight saving time, so during US summer the Arizona time matches Pacific time, and during winter it matches Mountain time. If you are in the east, remember the time difference when you plan a call.

## The support chat
On every page of the website, a chat button at the bottom right opens a support panel with quick answers to common questions and one-tap ways to contact us by WhatsApp, phone or email. If live chat is enabled, a Live chat button appears too. It is the fastest route to the right channel from wherever you are on the site.

## WhatsApp
Message us on WhatsApp for quick questions, order updates or to receive payment details in chat. Use the button on our website so that the message starts with your order reference. Our number is +1 774-734-1372. WhatsApp is convenient on a phone, and you can send photos and screenshots in the chat. For anything that needs a written record, such as damage or a refund, follow up by email as well. See [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/).

## Email
Email is best for photos, receipts and anything that needs a written record. Our support address is sales@onestopvapestore.com. Include your order ID and a clear description. Attach photos or screenshots directly, and keep each message to one topic so it is easy to follow. Email is the right choice for damage reports, return requests, wholesale enquiries and anything you may want to refer to later.

## Phone
Call during business hours for urgent issues, at 774-734-1372. A call is useful when you need to talk something through, such as an exchange, a lost parcel or a payment problem. Have your order ID ready, and the email address you used. If you reach voicemail, leave your name, order ID and a good time to call back.

## The contact form
The form on the [contact page](/contact/) sends your message to our order dashboard and emails you a confirmation. Choose the subject that matches your query so it reaches the right person, and include your order ID in the message. It is a good route when you want a written record without opening your email app.

## What to include
A complete message gets a faster reply. Include:

- **Your order ID,** which starts with OSV-.
- **The email address and name** you used on the order.
- **A clear description** of the problem or question.
- **Photos** for damage or wrong items.
- **A screenshot** for payment questions.
- **The tracking number** for delivery questions.
- **What you would like us to do,** such as replace, refund, check or explain.

## How we respond
We aim to answer quickly during business hours, and we reply in the same channel where we can. If we need more information we will ask. If an issue needs investigation, such as a lost parcel, we tell you what we are doing and when to expect an update. We do not ask for passwords, PINs, card numbers, private keys or recovery phrases through any channel.

## Which channel for which problem?
- **Quick question about an order:** WhatsApp or the support chat.
- **Payment question or proof:** the private order page, then email or WhatsApp.
- **Damage or missing items:** email with photos.
- **Return or refund:** email or phone, and wait for the RMA.
- **Delayed parcel:** email or WhatsApp with the tracking number.
- **Wholesale pricing:** the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) or email.
- **Account, privacy or data requests:** email from the address on your order.

## Before you contact us
Many answers are in the [FAQ](/faq/), the [shipping policy](/shipping/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/). You can also read [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/), [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Checking first can answer your question in a minute, and it helps us when you do write, because you can tell us what you have already tried.

## Avoiding scams
Scammers sometimes imitate stores' support channels. Use only the contact details on our website and in our official emails. We never ask you to pay to a personal number or account that we have not provided through your order, we never ask for codes or recovery phrases and we never pressure you to pay quickly or keep a payment secret. If a message looks suspicious, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) to check it. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).

## Wholesale questions
Retailers can use the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) for volume pricing, and our [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) explains how larger orders work.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Which channel is fastest?
During business hours, WhatsApp and the support chat are usually fastest for simple questions. Email is best for anything that needs photos or a record.

### Can I contact you at the weekend?
You can send a message at any time, and we answer on the next business day. Automatic crypto payments continue to be matched at weekends.

### Do I need an order ID?
It is not required to ask a general question, but for anything about an order it is the quickest way for us to find it.

### Can someone else contact you for me?
We can speak to the person named on the order. If someone else contacts us for you, they will need the order ID and the details on the order, and we may confirm with you directly.

### What if I forgot my order ID?
Give us the name, email and approximate time and amount of the order, and we will find it.

Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Tips for getting a fast, useful answer
### Write one message, not five
A single message with everything we need is quicker to handle than a series of short ones. Put your order ID in the first line, describe the problem in two or three sentences and say what you would like us to do. If you have photos, attach them to the same message.

### Be specific about timing
Tell us when you ordered, when you paid, when the order shipped and when you expected it. Specific dates let us check the right records and tell you what is happening.

### Keep the thread together
Reply to our message rather than starting a new one, so that the history stays in one place. If you contact us through a different channel about the same issue, mention the earlier message.

### Be patient with complex cases
Some issues, such as a lost parcel or a disputed payment, need investigation with a carrier or a payment provider. We tell you what we are doing and when to expect an update, and we will follow up with you.

## Examples of good messages
**A payment question:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3. I paid $195.00 by Chime at 3:20pm today and uploaded a screenshot at 3:25pm. Status still shows proof submitted. Can you confirm it was received?"

**A delivery question:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3, tracking 123456789. Shipped on the 4th, estimate for my region was 11 to 18 business days, and tracking has shown no movement for six days. Can you check with the carrier?"

**A return request:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3, bought on the 1st. I would like to return one unopened bottle of [product] in original packaging. Please send an RMA form."

**A wholesale enquiry:** "I run a vape shop in [state] and would like volume pricing on [brands]. My business details are below."

Each message states the order, the facts and the request, so we can reply without asking anything first.

## When something is urgent
If a problem cannot wait, call during business hours and explain that it is urgent. Examples include a parcel that is about to be returned, a payment that may be made to the wrong details or a suspected scam. Follow up with an email so that there is a written record. For emergencies of a medical nature, contact a doctor or the relevant emergency service, not us.

## Feedback and suggestions
If you have feedback about our service, a suggestion for the website or a compliment for a team member, tell us. We read every message, and practical suggestions, such as a missing guide or an unclear page, often lead to changes. Use the contact form or email and mark the message as feedback, so it reaches the right person. If you were unhappy with how a problem was handled, say so plainly, with the order ID, and we will review it and respond.
